title: Normalized neuron
description: One canonical, normalized neuron record. This is derived data: it must retain immutable source identity and record-level provenance.

dataset_id.description: Internal dataset release identifier shared by all derived records.

source_dataset.description: Name or DOI of the immutable upstream dataset.

source_version.description: Upstream release/version from which this record was normalized.

body_id.description: Stable source-system neuron/body identifier; never replace it with dense_index.

neuron_id.description: Canonical normalized neuron identifier, unique within dataset_id.

dense_index.description: Zero-based dense simulation index. Indices must be unique and contiguous from 0 through N-1 within one dataset_id/source_version.

neurotransmitter.description: Predicted or curated transmitter label; use 'unknown' when no label is available.

neurotransmitter_confidence.description: Confidence in neurotransmitter assignment, normalized to [0,1].
